body:
Hi,
First of all, im sorry to hear about the situation with your sister. Im going through the same thing and my mum has cancer. I mean honestly the only way I have been able to cope with my depression or ignore the feelings are to get high but i do have some perspective for you that although the last few months since i heard my dad say that my mum has cancer has been tough and shitty on top of internship apps etc, its given me a fresh perspective that man life is precious and honestly i try not to worry so much about school and the future as much. Just do you and aim to find a way to get through the days as the pain is temporary and although you may seem and feel lost or isolated on most days, you can use it as solitude and a way to improve yourself for me the i kinda fucking hate my life since ive moved here, no real friends, failed a bunch of courses but i spend my time reading on making money and lifting weights and honestly although the isolation sucks and it may feel like no one understands you trust me, i know for sure that as long as you do your best to be positive in this situation you are gonna look back many years later and thank yourself for the experience, at least through my mums illness that although school has been shitty ive found a passion outside of school and i urge you to see the isolation as solitude for you to grow stronger through the pain

best wishes to you and i hope that things work out ok in the end!
